simple.meaning: צְבַע (tsᵉbaʻ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to dip.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 4:12. The surrounding contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְבַע (H6647) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: צְבַע (tsᵉbaʻ) / H6647 is traced through Daniel 4:12, Daniel 4:20, Daniel 4:22, Daniel 4:30 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

majorEvents.evidenceText: He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky; until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

timeline.evidenceText: The leaves of it were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;
it is you, O king, that have grown and become strong; for your greatness has grown, and reaches to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.
The king spoke and said, “Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?”

He was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys. He was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky; until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

definitions.full: H6647. tseba I. [ צְבַע ] verb dip, wet ( ᵑ7 Syriac; compare Biblical Hebrew I. צבע ); — Pa`el Participle active plural מְצַבְּעִין Dan 4:22 wet thee ( ל ), + מִטַּל . Hithpa. Imperfect יִצְטַבּע (also בַּ֑ע -), be wet , with בְּטַל Dan 4:12 ; 4:20 , מִטַּל 4:30 ; 5:21 . II. צבע (√ of following; compare Biblical Hebrew II. צבע ).
